title: Foo Bar Taxi Data Quality Gate
description: Pull January 2024 NYC taxi data from the TLC dataset, build an ingestion pipeline with quality gates that validates rows and separates valid records from rejected ones based on data quality rules.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must fetch NYC taxi trip data, build an ingestion pipeline with quality gates, and separate clean rows from rejected ones with documented rejection reasons.

tasks.description: Fetch January 2024 taxi data from the TLC dataset, validate rows against quality rules, and load valid and rejected rows into separate ClickHouse tables.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse running but empty. Agent must fetch parquet data from the NYC TLC public dataset and build the pipeline.
